mainEntity.name: Which is the No. 1 MBA college in India according to NIRF 2025?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad is ranked #1 in the NIRF 2025 Management ranking.

mainEntity.name: How many institutions are in the NIRF 2025 Management Top 100?

acceptedAnswer.text: The NIRF 2025 Management ranking lists the Top 100 institutions.

mainEntity.name: Does NIRF Management ranking include IITs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Several IITs, including IIT Delhi, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Madras, IIT Bombay, IIT Kanpur and IIT Roorkee, appear in the NIRF 2025 Management ranking.

mainEntity.name: Does NIRF rank only MBA programmes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. NIRF Management is an institutional ranking category. Students should check the specific MBA, PGDM or other management programme offered by an institution.

mainEntity.name: Is NIRF rank enough to choose an MBA college?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Students should also compare entrance requirements, total cost, placements, programme structure, location and career fit.
